design_gotchas.title: VIN Capped at 6.0 V (7.0 V Abs Max) vs Pin-Compatible 14 V LM27313/LM2733
design_gotchas.detail: TPS61040DBVR shares the exact SOT-23-5 pinout (1=SW, 2=GND, 3=FB, 4=EN, 5=VIN) and ~1.23 V VFB with LM27313XMF/NOPB and LM2733XMF/NOPB, but its VIN max is only 6.0 V (7.0 V abs max). Placing TPS61040DBVR on a 9 V or 12 V rail built for LM27313/LM2733 will immediately destroy the IC.

design_gotchas.title: Non-Synchronous Boost Requires External High-Voltage Schottky Diode & Offers No Load Disconnect
design_gotchas.detail: An external Schottky rectifier rated >= 30 V (e.g., MBR0530) is mandatory between SW and VOUT. Because this diode remains in the DC path even when EN is low, VOUT stays near VIN - Vf during shutdown.

design_gotchas.title: PFM Control Creates Load-Dependent Variable Frequency and Audible Ripple Risk
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike fixed-frequency 1.6 MHz PWM LM27313/LM2733, TPS61040 uses constant-peak-current PFM (up to 1 MHz) to achieve 28 uA quiescent current. At light loads, switching frequency drops into the audible band and output voltage ripple increases unless CFF is tuned.

design_gotchas.title: 400 mA Switch Limit Restricts High-Voltage Output Current
design_gotchas.detail: With a 400 mA typ (350 mA min) peak switch limit and 10 uH inductor, maximum load current at 3.3 V -> 18 V or 24 V is only tens of milliamps (~25-45 mA). Verify peak-to-average boost current ratios before substituting for higher-current boost ICs.

typical_use_cases: OLED and small-to-medium LCD bias power rails (12 V to 28 V) from 1-cell Li-Ion or 3.3 V/5 V bus
Series white-LED backlight driver for handheld instruments and portable displays
Low-Iq (28 uA) low-current 3.3 V/5 V to 12 V/15 V/24 V auxiliary analog rail generation
engineering_summary: The TPS61040DBVR is a low-quiescent-current (28 uA typ) non-synchronous PFM boost converter in SOT-23-5 (DBV) featuring a 30 V rated internal switch (400 mA typ / 350 mA min peak limit) for boosting 1.8 V to 6.0 V inputs up to 28 V outputs (VREF = 1.233 V). It matches the 5-pin SOT-23 pinout of LM27313XMF/NOPB and LM2733XMF/NOPB while offering ~14x lower no-load Iq, but is strictly limited to <= 6.0 V input, 400 mA switch current, and variable PFM frequency. Verify VIN ceiling, load current, and Schottky selection against the official TI datasheet before production.
